common.tagline: Enter your website, Sova runs your social media.

landing.metaTitle: Sova · AI that runs your social media
landing.metaDescription: Enter your website and Sova learns your brand, builds a strategy, writes posts and visuals, schedules them on eight networks and learns from the results.

errors.notFoundText: The link may be wrong or the page has moved.
errors.errorText: The error has been recorded. Try again, and if it keeps happening contact support with the ID below.
errors.offline: No internet connection. We will retry when the connection is back.

design.title: Post design
design.description: Style, colours and photos for posts, carousels and stories. Used by the Studio and automation flows.

photoSource.label: Photos in posts
photoSource.galleryHint: Photos you added to the library.

colors.label: Brand colours
colors.contrast: Text is hard to read on this background. Slides will pick a more readable colour automatically.

handle.label: Handle on slides
handle.hint: Empty: the handle from your connected Instagram.

headline.name: Headline + Subtext
headline.desc: Headline and subtext with an accent bar on a light background.

bold.name: Bold Statement
bold.desc: One strong sentence over a full brand colour.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.desc: Magazine layout: a framed photo and a headline with plenty of white space.

cover.name: Cover
cover.desc: Full-bleed photo with a headline band at the bottom.

poster.name: Poster
poster.desc: Full-bleed photo, a dark gradient and a big headline at the bottom.

cards.name: Cards
cards.desc: Content in clean cards on a tint of the brand colour.

linen.name: Linen
linen.desc: Warm editorial style with organic details.

social.name: Social
social.desc: Looks like a social post: profile, text and photo.

prism.name: Prism
prism.desc: Premium and minimal, with brand colour gradients.

popcard.name: Pop Card
popcard.desc: Playful style with a thick outline and rounded cards.

note.name: Note
note.desc: A notebook page: ruled lines, a handwritten title and a taped photo.

snap.name: Snap
snap.desc: A photo across the slide with a sticker-style caption.

meme.name: Meme
meme.desc: A photo with a big white caption and a black outline.

film.name: Film
film.desc: A 35 mm film frame: perforations, a framed photo and mono labels.

pamphlet.name: Pamphlet
pamphlet.desc: Letterpress poster: grainy paper, dense type and red accents.

quote.name: Quote Card
quote.desc: A quote or statement with attribution.

stat.name: Stat Highlight
stat.desc: One striking number with a short explanation.

list.name: List Slide
list.desc: Numbered slides for tips and lists.

duotone.name: Duotone
duotone.desc: A photo with a strong brand colour tone.

framed.name: Framed
framed.desc: A framed photo with a headline strip in the brand colour.

event.name: Event Promo
event.desc: Event name, date and venue for announcements.

mono.name: Minimal Mono
mono.desc: Lots of white space, a subtle premium tone, no photo.

flows.title: Automate posts
flows.subtitle: Flows prepare drafts on your schedule. Every draft goes to approval before it is published.

empty.title: No flows yet
empty.text: A flow is one topic with a format, a style and preparation days. Sova then creates drafts and sends them for approval.

actions.confirmDelete: Delete the flow “{name}”? Drafts it created will stay.

progress.title: Sova is preparing a draft
progress.text: Creating a post from the flow “{name}”. It usually takes less than a minute.
progress.hint: You can close this window. Preparation continues and the draft will arrive in approvals.

wizard.topicIntro: One topic per flow. Sova uses your brand and analytics.
wizard.name: Flow name
wizard.topicPlaceholder: E.g. explaining one SEO term through a simple comparison or a list of 3 to 4 points
wizard.ctaMode: Call to action at the end of the post
wizard.ctaNoneHint: The call leads to the link in bio, the website or following the profile.
wizard.ctaDmHint: Coming soon: a message with a link to everyone who comments a keyword.
wizard.colorsHint: Colours and the handle on slides come from the brand design.
wizard.networksHint: Every draft gets the same networks in approvals and the calendar.
wizard.autoAccountsHint: An account you connect later joins the next drafts when it supports the format.
wizard.noAccounts: No connected networks. Connect an account on the Networks page.
wizard.daysHint: Choose at least one day. Sova then creates a draft and sends it for approval.
wizard.autoTimeHint: A stable slot between 07:00 and 21:45, so flows do not start in the same minute.
wizard.summary: Schedule: {days}, {time}. The finished draft goes to approval.
wizard.collaboratorsHint: Up to three profiles. When they accept, the post also appears on their profile.

review.title: Approvals
review.subtitle: Review what Sova prepared, refine it and decide when it goes out.

empty.waiting: No drafts are waiting for a decision.

review.select: Choose a draft on the left.

actions.confirmSkip: Skip this draft? You can restore it from the post editor.
actions.confirmPublish: Publish now to the selected networks?
actions.confirmRegenerate: Create new copy and new slides? It uses {tokens} tokens.

panel.caption: Caption
panel.captionHint: Hashtags go at the end of the caption.
panel.timezone: Time in the brand time zone ({tz})
panel.noApprove: Your role can edit the copy; the owner, an admin or an approver approves it.

setup.title: Let's set up Sova for {brand}
setup.subtitle: Seven short steps. You can change everything later.
setup.skipConfirm: Skip setup? You can set everything up later under Brand and Flows.
setup.viewOnly: Your role can only view. The owner or an editor goes through setup.
setup.completed: Setup was finished on {date}. You can go through it again; flows won't be duplicated.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sova
welcome.text: Sova writes and designs posts for your brand, and you approve them before they go out. First, pick a language.
welcome.uiLocaleHint: Menus, buttons and messages in the app.
welcome.contentLocaleHint: Sova writes posts in this language. You can pick another one for a single post or flow.

networks.title: Connect your networks
networks.text: Sova only posts where you allow it. You enter your password on the network's own page; Sova never sees it.
networks.adminOnly: Networks are connected by the workspace owner or an admin.
networks.pickText: The network returned these accounts. Tick the ones Sova may post to.
networks.none: No networks connected yet. You can also do this later from the Networks menu.
networks.denied: Connecting was canceled on the network.
networks.empty: The network returned no accounts. Instagram has to be a business account linked to a Facebook page.

analysis.title: Let Sova get to know your brand
analysis.text: Sova reads your website, brand documents and earlier posts. That way it writes in your style and doesn't make up facts.
analysis.siteHint: The first analysis is free and takes a minute or two.
analysis.succeeded: The website has been read and the brand profile is ready.
analysis.done: The website has already been analyzed. Only run a new analysis if the site has changed.
analysis.noSiteText: That's fine: add a PDF about your brand, or describe the brand in your own words in the next step.
analysis.verifyEmail: Confirm your email to start the analysis.
analysis.posts: Posts imported from networks: {count}. Sova learns from them how you write.
analysis.postsNone: Once you connect a network, Sova imports earlier posts and learns from them how you write.

phases.visual: Getting the logo, colors and fonts

brand.title: How your brand speaks
brand.text: These words take priority over what Sova concluded from the website. The topics at the bottom become automation flows.

colors.title: Brand colors
colors.text: Colors for slides and posts. If the website was analyzed, its colors are already here.

style.title: How posts look
style.text: Pick a style and where photos come from. You can change the style for every post and flow.

done.title: Topics become flows
done.text: Each topic is one flow. Twice a week Sova makes a carousel draft and sends it for approval, and nothing is posted without you.
done.cost: One draft costs {price, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}}. Flows switched on: {active}, which is about {perWeek, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} a week.
done.noTopics: No topics yet. Add them in the Brand step or create a flow later.
done.noAccounts: No network is connected yet, so flows are created paused. Switch them on once you connect an account.

banner.title: Finish setting up
banner.text: A few more steps and Sova starts making posts for {brand}.

voice.title: Brand voice
voice.description: Your own words about the brand. Sova uses them in every post, and they take priority over the website analysis.
voice.fromProfile: Suggested from the website analysis. Check it and save.

fields.offerPlaceholder: E.g. air conditioner installation and service in Belgrade, for flats and shops.
fields.audiencePlaceholder: E.g. flat and small shop owners who want a quick, clean installation.
fields.tonePlaceholder: E.g. relaxed and expert, no jargon, a bit of humor.
fields.uspPlaceholder: E.g. installation in one day, two-year warranty, we clean up after ourselves.
fields.avoidPlaceholder: E.g. no mentions of competitors, no prices in posts, never the word “cheapest”.
fields.ctaPlaceholder: E.g. Call 060 123 4567 or send us a message.

topics.label: Main topics
topics.hint: Up to {max} topics. Sova writes about these regularly.
topics.placeholder: E.g. Tips for servicing your AC before summer
topics.full: You've added {max} topics, the most allowed.

draft.button: Suggest from sources ({price, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}})
draft.hint: Sova reads the website analysis, documents and earlier posts. It only fills empty fields and adds topics.
draft.noSources: A suggestion needs at least one source: a website analysis, a PDF or a network with posts.
draft.done: The suggestion is in. Check it, then save.

documents.title: Brand documents
documents.description: A PDF with a company description, price list or communication rules. Sova reads it and uses it in posts.
documents.limits: Up to 10 MB, at most {max} documents per brand.
documents.tooLarge: A PDF can be at most 10 MB.

status.ready: Read: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}

documents.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? Sova will stop using it.
documents.verifyEmail: Confirm your email to add a document.
